$Enhanced Random Character (RandomPool) [offline] [Enhanced Random Character contributors, Synapse fork]
*Per-port random-character pools on the VS character select screen, for you and for the CPUs you set.
*D-pad Left / Right on a portrait: toggle it in your pool / your CPU pool (on your own card: clear it).
*Coin on a portrait = Fixed; on the left random strip = Instant (visible pick); on the mystery zone = Mystery (hidden, revealed at match load).
*Vanilla 1.02 and m-ex (ACE, Akaneia), auto-detected.
*SIZE WARNING: 405 code lines, nearly all of the ~408 that Dolphin (and console loaders such as Nintendont) hold for ALL enabled codes together, Dolphin's own enabled GALE01 codes included.
*Enable it ALONE: if the enabled codes go over the limit, NONE of them is applied (Dolphin shows "Ran out of memory applying gecko codes"), this one included.
*Don't enable it on a Synapse ISO built with the Character Random Pool (it would hook the same sites twice).
*Fork of https://github.com/2gifts/SSBMEnhancedRandomCharacter (MIT; Copyright (c) 2026 the Enhanced Random Character contributors). Fork changes: Copyright (c) 2026 w3irDv, MIT.
*Fixed vs upstream: console halt (costume reset written to unmapped 0x008C78DD); Ready read the wrong slot's flag; a Mystery CPU came back closed (N/A) after a match or Rules; state block at 0x804D6AA0 overwritten by stage setup (moved to 0x8032E880); m-ex READY TO FIGHT while carrying another slot's coin (memp_kouho crash).
*Added vs upstream: a CPU pool per human; pools edited with the D-pad instead of L / R (ACE uses L for Beyond Melee variants); 120-icon pools (ACE's Roy, Lucina, Mr. Game & Watch poolable); Fixed / Instant / Mystery kept per slot across matches, a carried coin rolls from the carrier's pool; Mystery also resolves on D-pad Down; the toggle aims where the hand points.
*Lost vs upstream: Slippi-online CSS support (offline only; use upstream for netplay).
*Not in this paste code (baked Synapse builds only): pooled portraits lit on the CSS; each pool member drawn once per round (here every pick is independent).
